headline: M2 gate: contrastive induction beats the hand tree decisively on live tau2 retail
findings: Induced tree more than triples the hand tree (0.667 vs 0.175 soft) and beats majority-class by 2.2x.

Rare classes (escalate 4, modify_user 6, politely_deny 5) are never separated: contrastive pairs are chosen from the top-2 majority labels at each node, so minority classes never get a dedicated question.
No 97%-precision operating point exists yet: the margin gate peaks at ~0.727 precision at 0.097 coverage. Confidence calibration, not routing, is the bottleneck for coverage-at-precision.

Frontier memorization is present in the final tree (product-name questions: tablet/camera/air purifier, ig 0.161-0.277). Candidate selection currently scores on all node examples with no validation split.
The root question is negation-framed (cert 0.461, the lowest in the tree) - fragile; refinement should rewrite negations into positive form.
Decisions API answer variance across identical calls is small but nonzero (macro_f1 0.4555 live vs 0.4536 cache replay).
next_moves: Validation-split candidate selection inside induction (k-fold over 114) to suppress memorized questions
Minority-class contrastive pairs: force one-vs-rest proposals for classes below a support threshold
Negation rewrite refinement for low-certainty questions
Temperature scaling on cached p-vectors, then re-examine the coverage-at-precision curve
